scope: CPU native, MINI F64, optimization partition only; after typed collector storage, before any matrix-update optimization.
method: One sequential driver per case; wait 2s, then macOS sample PID 7 1. Symbols demangled with rustc-demangle 0.1.28. Percentages count execution-stack samples, not wall-clock timings.
filter: Keep only stacks below mech_gpu::native_artifact::program::runtime::execute; exclude parsing, JIT, input import, cache flush and output serialization.
attribution: Action categories are disjoint call-boundary classifications. Self mechanisms are a separate disjoint leaf-symbol classification. Inclusive function percentages overlap and must not be summed. Compiler inlining, unresolved JIT symbols and sampling uncertainty limit precision.
validation: All five warm-up live-outs pass the pinned finite C comparison. All timed driver calls succeeded; profile runs are not performance qualification receipts.
weighting: Runtime-weighted estimates below use round-01 medians, normalized to the five profiled cases. They prioritize total CPU cost; the primary goal still weights all 15 holdout programs equally.
